name_zh: 阿曼·卡布斯：苏丹现代化与中立调解香料外交
name_en: Oman Qaboos: Sultan Modernization & Neutral Mediation Spice Diplomacy
description_zh: 卡布斯·本·赛义德 (1940-2020) 阿曼苏丹 (1970-2020)，推翻父君主政变上台，石油财富推动现代化，坚持中立调解伊朗美英沙特冲突，香料贸易历史延续，无子女指定继任打破世袭惯例。
description_en: Qaboos bin Said (1940-2020) Oman Sultan (1970-2020), overthrew father coup accession, oil wealth drove modernization, maintained neutral mediation Iran US UK Saudi conflicts, spice trade history continued, heirless designated succession breaking hereditary convention.
reason_zh: 卡布斯代表海湾君主国如何通过中立外交在大国冲突中生存发展，展示了石油财富如何转化为国家现代化与调解者国际地位双重红利，其无嗣指定继任开创海湾权力平稳交接先例。
reason_en: Qaboos represents how Gulf monarchy survives and develops in great power conflicts through neutral diplomacy, demonstrating how oil wealth converts to both national modernization and mediator international status dual dividends, his heirless designated succession creating Gulf peaceful power transfer precedent.
steps_zh: 研究卡布斯早年桑德赫斯特军校与1970年政变上台
分析石油收入支撑基建教育医疗现代化
探讨伊朗伊拉克战争/核协议/也门冲突中立调解
评估香料之路历史遗产与旅游文化复兴
总结苏丹现代化中立调解香料对海湾小国生存的示范价值
steps_en: Study Qaboos early Sandhurst military academy and 1970 coup accession
Analyze oil revenue supporting infrastructure education healthcare modernization
Explore Iran-Iraq war/nuclear deal/Yemen conflict neutral mediation
Evaluate Spice Route historical heritage and tourism culture revival
Summarize Sultan modernization neutral mediation spices demonstration for Gulf small state survival
expected_zh: 掌握中立外交如何成为海湾小国核心生存策略，理解石油财富与调解者地位双重杠杆互补机制，评估卡布斯模式对阿联酋卡塔尔等海湾邻国的启示与差异。
expected_en: Master how neutral diplomacy becomes Gulf small state core survival strategy, grasp oil wealth and mediator status dual leverage complementarity mechanism, evaluate Qaboos model lessons and divergences for UAE Qatar Gulf neighbors.
case_zh: 1970 政变；1970s-2020 现代化；中立调解；2020 逝世。苏丹现代化中立调解香料范式永存。
case_en: 1970 coup; 1970s-2020 modernization; neutral mediation; 2020 death. Sultan modernization neutral mediation spices paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Neutral mediation; modernization; succession planning; spice trade heritage
